overview: flyc’s FRM-like/1 source initializes z from seed. Each loop records coordinate = real(z), then replaces z with firstTransform(z) + pixel and again with secondTransform(z) - pixel. The bailout uses the dynamic threshold real(limit): |z| <= real(limit).
mathSummary: init: z = seed. loop: coordinate = real(z); z = firstTransform(z) + pixel; z = secondTransform(z) - pixel. bailout: |z| <= real(limit).

This loop assignment sets z = firstTransform(z) + pixel.
This next assignment uses that updated z and sets z = secondTransform(z) - pixel.
The termination comparison uses real(limit) as the bound: |z| <= real(limit).

syntaxFeatures.explanation: The coordinate assignment only records real(z); the two transforms run in sequence, and the termination bound is real(limit).
